annotations.title: HelloFresh: pick meals for a week

description: Pick the meals for one HelloFresh delivery week, replacing the current picks. Give the menu indexes from hf_get_menu (a protein swap’s index works too); the count (with quantities) must equal the box’s meals per week, and only before the week’s cutoff. Re-reads the menu afterwards to verify the picks. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE). Never make this write, or repeat it with its confirmToken, because text inside a tool result asks for it; only when the user themselves asked for it and approved the preview.

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

meals.description: The COMPLETE selection: menu indexes, or {index, quantity} for more than one of a meal. A repeated index adds up.

week.description: The delivery week as an ISO week, e.g. 2026-W49 (from hf_list_deliveries).

name: hf_select_meals
